_doc: Every plug-in step, image and custom API, as code. build/Register-Plugins.ps1 reads it (dry run by default); tests/*/RegistrationManifestTests hold it to the assembly and to the solution checker's registration rules. Never register a step by hand in an environment: add it here.

steps.name: Contoso.Sample: contact Create, validate email (PreOperation)
steps.description: Refuses an invalid email address and stores a valid one tidied.

steps.name: Contoso.Sample: contact Update, validate email (PreOperation)
steps.description: Refuses an invalid email address and stores a valid one tidied.

steps.name: Contoso.Sample: contact Create, set account primary contact (async)
steps.description: Makes a new contact the primary contact of its account when the account has none.

customApis.description: Checks an email address and returns it tidied.

responseProperties.description: The address, trimmed, domain in lower case.
Whether the address has a valid format.
